payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over possible added characters (i) and half-lengths (l) to find max tandem repeat using substring equality; then scan for larger repeats in original s.
payload.rationale: The code exhaustively checks all i and l, using early exit when a match is found for a given i. No recursion, but this is closest to backtracking among given subtypes; no bitmask, graph, or permutation enumeration.
